Update the 2026-11-18 at 09:32:24

The update of the conditions is done every morning before 7am. Please note that between 7 a.m. and 9 a.m., conditions are subject to change. Temperature, wind and trail traffic can influence snow conditions, the number of trails open and the number of chairlifts in operation, which are reassessed during the day. If there are any changes, they will be made as soon as possible on our website.

Thank you for the season

April 16, 2026

Unfortunately, with the rain we’ve had over the past week—and more expected through Saturday morning—the trails would require a significant amount of grooming work in a very short time to open for one last day. We’d like to extend a big thank you to all the skiers who joined us during our more than 120 days of operation this season.

Due to the thaw, the mountain is now closed to all sporting activities, including ski touring and hiking.
Stay tuned for our upcoming announcements to find out the opening date for the summer hiking season.

Thank you for your understanding, and see you next year!
